name: Our Years Together
source:
Shuichi Saihara's years through Hope's Peak Academy.

This is a Saimatsu heavy fangame of [url=/v18334]New Dangan Ronpa V3 Minna no Koroshiai Shingakki[/url], where everyone attends Hope's Peak Academy together. Think of it like an extended version of the Ultimate Hope Plan, yeah?

[From [url=https://icyleaves.itch.io/our-years-together]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
西原秀一在希望之峰学园的岁月。

这是[url=/v18334]New Dangan Ronpa V3 Minna no Koroshiai Shiningakki[/url]的齐松重度同人游戏，大家一起在希望之峰学园上学。把它想象成终极希望计划的扩展版本，是吗？
